facts.fact: Daily News reports Wingu Africa launched Wingu Cloud Exchange (WCX), a locally hosted, carrier-neutral private cloud (compute, Kubernetes, security) sold to Tanzanian organisations from its Tanzanian facilities, priced in local currency; as_of is the publication date.

note: Interview mentions rising demand for Tier III infrastructure but does not state that a facility is Tier III; no cloud-region fact (private cloud, not a global provider region).
